note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; soldier, worker and alate castes are all described, the nymph is not. Where the original antennal segment count is read as l3 in the OCR, 13 segments are recorded. Synonymy citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Soldier: head capsule dark brown; antennae and labrum much paler than the head; mandibles dark brown with a reddish tinge; remainder of body pale yellow. Head sparsely pilose, body more densely so. Total body length 4.9–5.60 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, sides almost parallel, length to base of mandibles 1.30–1.63 mm, maximum width 0.85–0.92 mm. Fontanelle minute, its trace indistinct. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 2 twice as long as segment 3, segment 3 smallest. Labrum with straight sides, anterior margin rounded, broadly narrowed, length 0.20 mm, width 0.25 mm. Mandibles short and thick, finely serrate, 0.80 mm long, slightly more than half the head length, mandible length/head length ratio 0.53–0.61; apex incurved. Postmentum clavate, waist situated in the posterior quarter, length 0.87–0.92 mm, maximum width 0.30–0.32 mm, waist width 0.20–0.22 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin with a weak emargination, posterior margin straight, length 0.30–0.32 mm, width 0.55–0.61 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Worker: head capsule pale brown, remainder of body pale yellow. Pilosity of head and body rather dense. Total body length 3.0–4.7 mm. Head capsule subquadrate, length to base of mandibles 0.56–0.87 mm, maximum width 0.70–0.87 mm. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 smallest. Postclypeus moderately convex, pilose, length about half its width. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin with a weak emargination, posterior margin slightly concave in the middle, length 0.22–0.26 mm, width 0.45–0.52 mm.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Alate: head capsule brown; postclypeus, pronotum and abdominal tergites paler than the head; wings pale brown with a smoky tinge. Head and body densely pilose. Body length without wings 4.0–5.58 mm. Head capsule subquadrate, sides nearly parallel, length to base of mandibles 0.65–0.70 mm, width including compound eyes 0.79–0.86 mm; V-shaped suture indistinct. Frontal plate oval, slightly raised. Compound eye subcircular, maximum diameter 0.22 mm; slightly protruding, its distance to the lower margin of the head one third of its diameter. Ocellus oval, maximum diameter 0.09 mm; close to the compound eye, the eye-ocellus distance 0.02–0.04 mm. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 smallest. Postclypeus convex, length about half its width. Pronotum flat, trapezoidal, length 0.37–0.44 mm, width 0.57–0.67 mm; anterior margin nearly straight with a very weak median emargination; posterior margin nearly straight, without emargination. Wing membrane and anterior and posterior margins with a few hairs; anterior margin with 1–3 rows of spine-like papillae, posterior margin with one row, membrane with dark brown non-stellate and stellate microtrichia. Fore wing 6.2–6.9 mm long, hind wing 5.9–6.2 mm long.
